description: The Account Owned API token value is a secret: mark it sensitive so it decodes as Redacted. The docs type both CreateTokenResponse.value and the roll (PUT .../tokens/{token_id}/value) result as the shared TokenValue model, a string documented as 'The token value' (the roll example is "result": "8M7wS6hCpXVc-DoRnPPY_UCWPgy8aea4Wy6kCe5T"). The roll result converts as an untyped document, so it is also typed string here.
